setup.input_units: native; encoder units are twice the detents

steps.caption: Channel 1 plays four trigs with note masks 60, 64, 69 and 71 on steps 1-4 (velocities 127, 117, 107, 97), in a scale with Degree II and Rotation 1; both are already set in the scale editor. In PARAMS > MOSAIC, Snap note masks to scale is On, while Quantise note masks (the global full-quantisation option) and Lock merged to pent. are Off. With Snap alone the masks play as written, 60, 64, 69, 71 in the MIDI strip, because Degree and Rotation affect masks only under full quantisation. Quantise Note Mask works on three levels, strongest first: a step lock, then the channel value, then the global option. On follows the scale, Off keeps the written pitch, and X means inherit from the next level down. Each step below lists the state as global / channel / step 1 / step 2. Now: Off / X / X / X.
steps.title: Starting point

steps.caption: State: On / X / X / X. Press K1, open the Mosaic params and turn Quantise note masks On (the global option). Play, then stop: the same masks now follow Degree II and Rotation 1 and the strip reads 62, 65, 71, 60.
steps.title: Global: turn full quantisation On

steps.caption: State: On / Off / X / X. Open Channel tasks > Trig params, press K2 and turn E3 to Quantise Note Mask in the parameter list. Press K3 to assign it and K2 to return, then turn E3 one detent to Off. Play, then stop: the written phrase 60, 64, 69, 71 returns, because the channel setting beats the global On.
steps.title: Channel: an Off beats the global On

steps.caption: State: On / Off / X / On. Hold step 2 and turn E3 to On to lock that step, then release. Play, then stop: only step 2 changes, to 65. The strip reads 60, 65, 69, 71.
steps.title: Step: map just one step
